custom_patterns.message: Feature not available in this repository.

interpretation_limits: The corpus uses non-issued shapes, so this result does not measure detection of a current provider-issued credential.
The corpus was pushed in one commit; no included value blocked that push, but the result does not measure per-scenario latency.
The alert export is a point-in-time API observation and asynchronous processing may complete later.
Generic, AI-detected, provider, validity-check, and custom-pattern capabilities have different feature and plan boundaries.
